question: Which inhibitory cells in R1's network, other than I1, does the DNg75_R / DNa02_L rhythm need, and are any of them needed by both?
not_claimed: anything about the live LIF engine
a change to motor admission or mappings
known_before: Transmitters of E1 (IN17A001_L, acetylcholine), E2 (INXXX466_L, acetylcholine), I1 (IN16B036_L, glutamate). No candidate has been counted or listed.

sources.cache: maleCNS cache (load_cache verifies the canonical source fingerprints)
sources.hash_rule: text files: sha256 after CRLF -> LF; .bin/.flys and evidence result.json: sha256 of raw bytes

stage_A.matrix: R1's signed W[post, pre] = sign(pre) x synapse count (count >= 5) within the 2,111-neuron network; inhibitory = R1 sign < 0 (GABA, glutamate)
stage_A.excluded: network DNs and ANs, the 68 front-left MNs, E1, E2, I1
stage_A.T1: inhibitory k with max_e W[k, e] > 0 and max_e' -W[e', k] > 0 (e, e' in {E1, E2}); strength = min of the two
stage_A.T2: only if |T1| < 5: inhibitory k not in T1 with max_e' -W[e', k] > 0 and some network x with max_e W[x, e] > 0 and W[k, x] > 0; strength = max_e' -W[e', k]
stage_A.ranking: strength descending, ties by dense index ascending; T1 first, then T2 fills remaining slots

stage_B.conditions_per_target: STIM; SIL_SHAM (R5 rule: one cell per replicate, default_rng(seed + 7,000,000), eligible = network cells not DN/AN/MN/E1/E2/I1/target two-hop intermediates/candidates); SIL_GROUP (all candidates); SIL_<dense> per candidate in rank order
stage_B.order: I2 first; then DNg75_R, then DNa02_L; within a target STIM, SIL_SHAM, SIL_GROUP, candidates in rank order
stage_B.storage: every run stored; per-MN detail only for runs with score >= 0.5

model: R1's model and R3's replicate function unchanged (b 0.03; 1 s; onset 20 ms; window 250..999 ms); silencing holds activation at 0.

acceptance.validity: per target: STIM score >= 0.5 and SIL_SHAM score >= 0.5, else INVALID

classes.NEEDED_CORE_OFF: score not >= 0.5 (NaN counts as abolished) and E1 active in < half the replicates
classes.NEEDED_OSCILLATION: score not >= 0.5, E1 active in >= half, median E1 trace rhythmicity < 0.5
classes.NEEDED_OTHER: score not >= 0.5, E1 active in >= half, E1 trace rhythmicity >= 0.5

verdict_order: INCONCLUSIVE: integrity failure or both targets INVALID
SHARED_INHIBITORY_PARTNER: >= 1 candidate NEEDED_OSCILLATION for both targets (both valid)
TARGET_SPECIFIC_PARTNER: >= 1 candidate NEEDED_OSCILLATION for one valid target
REDUNDANT_INHIBITION: no single candidate, SIL_GROUP NEEDED_OSCILLATION for >= 1 valid target
GROUP_SILENCES_CORE: no single candidate, SIL_GROUP NEEDED_CORE_OFF for >= 1 valid target
acceptance.multiplicity: no correction across candidates; every candidate's class is reported

reported_not_gated: candidate tier, body ID, name, transmitter, loop weights
E1/E2/I1 trace rhythmicity and mean rates
whether each candidate is a two-hop intermediate of either target

integrity.I1: source hashes; R1 network body-ID hash; E1/E2 acetylcholine and I1 glutamate; R1b z*/m_VNC reproduced; candidates <= 40 and contain no DN, AN, MN, core cell or I1
integrity.I2_r5_reproduction: hard gate: R5 R1SIZE STIM for DNg75_R and DNa02_L, seeds 2001-2004 (8 simulations), must equal R5's stored runs exactly (score, recruited, core activity)
integrity.I3_tests: tests/test_dng100_inhibition_search.py passes (candidate rule on toy W: tiers, exclusions, cap, ranking; classes; validity; verdict order; expectations; I2 check)
integrity.I4: 2 x (N + 3) x 32 simulations plus 8 reproduction simulations

expectations.note: recorded in the design before any candidate was listed; wrong ones are recorded as wrong

plumbing_disclosure: Before registration one R1SIZE DNg75_R simulation at seed 0 (not a protocol seed) was timed (0.61 s); no candidate was computed; its score and rates were not printed. Unit tests use toy matrices only.
execution: one command (--output) computes the candidates, runs I2 and all conditions, and evaluates in the same process; output opened exclusively; run once in the background.
interpretation_limits: R1's sizes only, at one drive; the rhythm is absent with cord-only sizes at R3's drive.
Short loops only (T1, T2 if needed), capped at 40 candidates.
Single-cell and whole-group silencing only; no pairs or subsets.
Reconstructed rate model; R1's transmitter signs; 68 bodymap MNs.
Neural only: no body or physics; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
